caveats: Offscreen CPU measurements do not measure native GPU frame latency.
The deterministic GPUI test text system does not measure production operating-system font shaping or glyph rasterization latency.
First-draw measures one observation after a layout/direction change, not a repeated cold-cache distribution.
Decorative motion is disabled to exclude rich-action hover animation under the deterministic test pointer. Descriptions has no component animation.
Measurements include UiRoot composition and complete forced native subtree redraws; offscreen rows are not virtualized.
The development machine was shared with concurrent build and visual work, so timing values are observations rather than fixed performance guarantees.
Resident memory, allocation counts and cache capacities were not instrumented; no measured bounded-memory or bounded-cache claim is made.
The offscreen matrix uses default solid borders; custom dashed/dotted paint costs are not benchmarked.
Native font observations use warmed scenes and caches, not a repeated cold-start distribution. CPU timings exclude GPU completion fences and screenshot readback.
Native/browser visual parity for dotted widths above 3 CSS pixels remains unverified; deterministic 4/5/8-pixel paint geometry tests cover complete round endpoints.
